title: ledger/v1
description: ledger/<identity>.json (D-19): what one identity contributed, as artifacts rather than as a score. Append-only and bot-owned — every entry is written by the post-merge job from a merge that already happened, so the ledger is derived from the graph's history and never a second source of truth (D-35). Each entry names one of D-19's six lines, the artifact it is, and where it merged; F07 writes two of them, `proof` and `attempts`, and the rest arrive with the features that earn them. There is no weight, no score and no ranking: relative significance is assigned retrospectively at write-up (D-19, D-32), and a ledger that carried a number would be the prospective difficulty scalar D-25 refuses. `status` exists because all credit is versioned and revocable (D-18): revocation flips it and keeps the entry.

identity.description: The pseudonym D-19 says the ledger shows; the network stores no other name

line.description: Which of D-19's six lines this entry is on. F07 writes proof and attempts.

artifact.description: Path of the file this entry is for, relative to the node directory

tooling.description: Model and tooling as declared at submission (D-23); undeclared when the pull request carried no opn-submission block

route_class.description: D-13's class, on an attempts entry only — what makes first-per-route-class checkable from the ledger itself

status.description: All credit is versioned and revocable (D-18); a revoked entry is kept, not deleted
